# Gravity Flip

A minimalist HTML canvas game where a ball falls under gravity. Clicking (or tapping) flips gravity, letting the ball bounce between the floor and ceiling while dodging horizontally moving spikes. The game ends when the ball collides with a spike or falls out of bounds.

<content>
1: // Minimal gravity‑flip game for a <canvas id="game"></canvas>
2: // Ball falls under gravity; click toggles gravity direction.
3: // Spikes move left; collision ends the game.
4: 
5: (() => {
6:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
7:   // Audio setup
8:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
9:   function beep(freq, duration) {
10:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
11:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
12:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
13:     osc.type = 'sine';
14:     osc.connect(gain);
15:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
16:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
17:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
18:     osc.start();
19:     setTimeout(() => {
20:       gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.02);
21:       osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.03);
22:     }, duration);
23:   }
24:   if (!canvas) return;
25:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
26:   // Full‑size canvas
27:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
28:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
29:   const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
30: 
31:   // Ball state
32:   let score = 0; // track passed spikes
33:   const ball = { x: W / 4, y: H / 2, r: 10, vy: 0 };
34:   let gravity = 0.5; // positive = downwards
35: 
36:   // Spikes array
37:   const spikes = [];
38:   const spikeWidth = 20, spikeHeight = 20;
39:   const spikeSpeed = 2;
40:   let spawnTimer = 0;
41: 
42:   let gameOver = false;
43: 
44:   // Flip gravity on click / tap
45:   canvas.addEventListener('click', () => { audioCtx.resume(); gravity = -gravity; beep(440, 100); });
46: 
47:   function update(dt) {
48:     // ball physics
49:     ball.vy += gravity;
50:     ball.y += ball.vy;
51:     // bounce off floor/ceiling
52:     if (ball.y + ball.r > H) { ball.y = H - ball.r; ball.vy = -Math.abs(ball.vy) * 0.7; }
53:     if (ball.y - ball.r < 0) { ball.y = ball.r; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy) * 0.7; }
54: 
55:     // spikes move left
56:     for (let i = spikes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
57:       spikes[i].x -= spikeSpeed;
58:       if (spikes[i].x + spikeWidth < 0) {
59:         spikes.splice(i, 1);
60:         score++;
61:       }
62:     }
63: 
64:     // spawn spikes periodically
65:     spawnTimer -= dt;
66:     if (spawnTimer <= 0) {
67:       spawnTimer = 1500; // ms
68:       const y = Math.random() * (H - spikeHeight);
69:       spikes.push({ x: W, y, direction: Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'up' : 'down' });
70:     }
71: 
72:     // collision detection (circle‑rectangle)
73:     for (const s of spikes) {
74:       const closestX = Math.max(s.x, Math.min(ball.x, s.x + spikeWidth));
75:       const closestY = Math.max(s.y, Math.min(ball.y, s.y + spikeHeight));
76:       const dx = ball.x - closestX;
77:       const dy = ball.y - closestY;
78:       if (dx * dx + dy * dy < ball.r * ball.r) {
79:         beep(220, 200); // collision sound
80:         gameOver = true;
81:         break;
82:       }
83:     }
84:   }
85: 
86:   function draw() {
87:     // background gradient
88:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
89:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
90:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#004');
91:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
92:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
93:     // background gradient
94:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
95:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
96:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#004');
97:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
98:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
99:     // ball with radial gradient
100:     const ballGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
101:       ball.x - ball.r / 3,
102:       ball.y - ball.r / 3,
103:       ball.r / 4,
104:       ball.x,
105:       ball.y,
106:       ball.r
107:     );
108:     ballGrad.addColorStop(0, '#aaf');
109:     ballGrad.addColorStop(1, '#006');
110:     ctx.fillStyle = ballGrad;
111:     ctx.beginPath();
112:     ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
113:     ctx.fill();
114:     // spikes as triangles
115:     ctx.fillStyle = 'crimson';
116:     for (const s of spikes) {
117:       ctx.beginPath();
118:       if (s.direction === 'up') {
119:         ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y + spikeHeight);
120:         ctx.lineTo(s.x + spikeWidth / 2, s.y);
121:         ctx.lineTo(s.x + spikeWidth, s.y + spikeHeight);
122:       } else { // down
123:         ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y);
124:         ctx.lineTo(s.x + spikeWidth / 2, s.y + spikeHeight);
125:         ctx.lineTo(s.x + spikeWidth, s.y);
126:       }
127:       ctx.closePath();
128:       ctx.fill();
129:     }
130:     // score display
131:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
132:     ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
133:     ctx.textAlign = 'left';
134:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 30);
135:     // game over overlay
136:     if (gameOver) {
137:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
138:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
139:       ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
140:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
141:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
142:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2);
143:     }
144:   }
145: 
146:   let last = performance.now();
147:   function loop(now) {
148:     const dt = now - last; // ms
149:     last = now;
150:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
151:     draw();
152:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
153:   }
154:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
155: })();

(End of file - total 155 lines)
</content>
